{{DL|Vermilion City|Port|Vermilion Harbor}} }} '''Ekans the Ecstasy''' (Japanese: '''VS アーボ''' ''VS {{tt|Arbo|Ekans}}'') is the 57th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 17th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{Adv|Yellow}} appears ready to battle the [[Team Rocket Elite Trio]]. But then four of Yellow's Pokémon ''scatter'' and are blocked by Team Rocket's Pokémon. Ken says that he is ready to have a "little battle". Ken shows Yellow that his {{p|Voltorb}} and {{p|Electrode}} are faster than Yellow's {{p|Doduo}}, surprising Yellow. Al's {{p|Slowpoke}} uses {{m|Confusion}} on the [[S.S. Anne]] again and Yellow starts to worry more about the passengers of the ship than himself. Dody uses {{m|Whirlwind}} and all of Yellow's Pokémon, except for Dody and [[Pika]], disappear. Al's Slowpoke gives the ship one final Confusion, and every passenger (except Yellow) falls down into the ocean, while the Team Rocket Elite Trio is lifted up into the air. Then a strange {{m|String Shot|thread}} wraps around the passengers. It's [[Kitty]]'s String Shot! The thread is as good as lifesavers! The passengers of the S.S. Anne swim back to [[Vermilion City]]. Team Rocket seem to be ready for a possible counterattack, but their legs are frozen from [[Omny]]'s {{m|Ice Beam}}! Due to a misjudgment of Al's, Team Rocket falls into the sea, but swim up to the surface. Harry has his {{p|Ekans}} and {{p|Weezing}} attack with {{m|Acid}} and {{m|Sludge}}, respectively, pushing Yellow off the S.S. Anne. Fortunately, {{p|Graveler|Gravvy}} is there to catch Yellow. Pika gives Ekans and Weezing a fatal {{m|Thunder Shock}}. Then Team Rocket finds that the S.S. Anne is cut in two because of [[Ratty]]'s teeth and Gravvy is holding the two parts of the ship, with Yellow on top. With the threat of half a ship over them, the Team Rocket Elite Trio is forced to surrender. ==Major events== * {{adv|Yellow}} battles against the [[Team Rocket Elite Trio]] while trying to escape from them. * Yellow uses [[Kitty]] to help rescue the passengers that have fallen off the sinking boat. * The [[S.S. Anne]] sinks in the {{DL|Vermilion City|Port|Vermilion Harbor}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Yellow}} * [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]] * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Ken]] * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Al]] * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Harry]] * Passengers ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Raticate}} ([[Ratty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Doduo}} ([[Dody]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Graveler}} (Gravvy; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Omanyte}} ([[Omny]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Caterpie}} ([[Kitty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Ekans}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Harry]]'s) * {{p|Weezing}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Harry]]'s) * {{p|Slowpoke}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Al]]'s) * {{p|Hypno}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Al]]'s) * {{p|Electrode}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Ken]]'s) * {{p|Voltorb}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Ken]]'s) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * The [[Fire Stone]] is incorrectly called the Flame Stone in the [[VIZ Media]] edition. * In the {{pmin|Brazil|Brazilian Portuguese}} translation, {{p|Ekans}} is called {{p|Arbok}} during the whole chapter, including the title. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{yellow color light}}|bordercolor={{yellow color}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 阿柏蛇|VS Ekans}} |cs=Vs.
